comment: Obstacle room of the dev sandbox (stairs at the north edge of the terrain sandbox, R to draw again). Each visit draws 'features' different kinds among 'pool' (weight: how often). chasm / river: a band 'width' tiles wide across the arena, wandering a little, with 'bridges' crossings (river: 'fordKind' tiles instead of bridges when set); lake: a blob of 'kind' of size S, M or L (radius in tiles); ice_walls: 'count' short walls. Nothing is placed within 'spawnClear' tiles of the centre or the stairs, and a layout that cuts the room in two is drawn again.
